<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—a series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da with relative intensities matching the natural 13C abundance (M+1 ≈12.5 % of M, M+2 ≈1 % of M, etc.)—the only element that can be definitively identified from this pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
